checks.name: high-fidelity editable master
checks.detail: YN_TUANJIE_001_EDITABLE_HIGH.glb is 113819176 bytes with SHA-256 26eb6fa1b88ef4509c3ad46cfad943f865777612e6ff844a166fb40cba6962c6; it embeds a 7000x7000 PNG base-colour texture and a 2500x2500 PNG normal texture.

checks.name: web-standard editable profile
checks.detail: YN_TUANJIE_001_EDITABLE.glb is 45457960 bytes with SHA-256 3a54374b9dcc06a478eb76e2c659b3f56141ea20ad05e5097ffa8f03558d1a07; it embeds a 3072x3072 PNG base-colour texture and a 1024x1024 PNG normal texture.

checks.name: geometry parity
checks.detail: Both profiles preserve the same 48 meshes/primitives, 608634 vertices and 464288 triangles. Neither profile decimates the source High scan geometry.

checks.name: editable grouping and runtime baggage
checks.detail: Both profiles retain named mesh nodes grouped under site, unresolved details, level 01, level 02 and roof; each has 0 animations, 0 skins, 0 morph targets and 0 cameras.

checks.name: browser rendering quality
checks.detail: The viewer loads both colour and normal textures, enables derivative normal mapping and anisotropic filtering, and caps device pixel ratio at 2.5. Runtime validation reported MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE 8192 and an active normal map for both profiles.

checks.name: profile switching and local-file workflow
checks.detail: Automated browser checks loaded the 7000/2500 high profile, switched to the 3072/1024 standard profile with identical geometry counts, and loaded a local GLB through the file picker path.

checks.name: browser regression suite
checks.detail: The V5.3.5 local browser smoke suite passed 28 of 28 checks.

checks.name: source-evidence boundary
checks.detail: Higher-resolution textures improve visible surface detail but do not reconstruct holes, fragmented boundaries, vegetation artifacts, occlusion gaps, physical dimensions or orientation missing from the source scan.
